LanguageData.LP_CerebrumHunger.stages.0.label: brain matter deficit
LanguageData.LP_CerebrumHunger.stages.1.label: brain matter starvation
LanguageData.LP_CerebrumHunger.stages.1.description: Hunger gnaws at my mind; all I can think of is other people's brains.
LanguageData.LP_CerebrumHunger.stages.2.label: brain hunger
LanguageData.LP_CerebrumHunger.stages.2.description: Brains... I must eat brains right now!
LanguageData.LP_UndeadTaste.stages.0.label: taste of undeath
LanguageData.LP_UndeadTaste.stages.0.description: That thing had no living brain at all; my mouth is full of rot.
LanguageData.LP_HiveBroken.stages.0.label: hivemind severed
LanguageData.LP_HiveBroken.stages.0.description: A companion's mind vanished from the hivemind; the blank it left makes my head split.
LanguageData.LP_WitnessedBrainDevour.stages.0.label: witnessed brain devouring
LanguageData.LP_WitnessedBrainDevour.stages.0.descrip: I saw that thing bore its tentacles into someone's skull and suck the brain dry. Worse than cannibalism.
LanguageData.LP_BrainDevoured_Know_Abhorrent.stages.0: Someone's brain in the colony was sucked out. It's a blasphemy against every faith.
LanguageData.LP_BrainDevoured_Sacred.stages.0.label: sacred feast
LanguageData.LP_BrainDevoured_Sacred.stages.0.descrip: Another mind has joined the hivemind.
